subject: Freeing the threshold estimate in multigroup CFA

messages.author: fe93fbb3998f630f
messages.subject: Freeing the threshold estimate in multigroup CFA
parts:
Hi,
I am trying to establish a partial scalar invariance between groups in a categorical cfa using measurementInvarianceCat() function from semTools package. 
My code looks like this:
check<- measurementInvarianceCat(model.vars1,
                                          data = trust.imp, 
                                          group='agea',
                                          ordered = order.var,
                                          strict=T, 
                                          estimator="DWLS",
                                         group.partial = c("health|1~t1", "health|1~t2", "health|1~t3"))

My intention is to free the parameters of all the "health" variable thresholds. I have tried using c("health~1"), c("health|t1~1",..) and the parameters always end up fixed to equal between groups. I also couldn't make it work in cfa(). The group.partial statement work wonderfully with continuous intercepts but I struggle with categorical data. Is there a correct syntax for this or the only way is to compare models by manually typing all the restrictions? 

I would appreciate any help,

Tomasz

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Freeing the threshold estimate in multigroup CFA
parts: My intention is to free the parameters of all the "health" variable thresholds. The group.partial statement work wonderfully with continuous intercepts but I struggle with categorical data. Is there a correct syntax for this or the only way is to compare models by manually typing all the restrictions?

Looks like you were conflating the intercept operator (~1) with the threshold operator (|t1).  This should work:

c("health|t1", "health|t2", "health|t3")
